scope: Source-bound literature map for proposed Lean4 work; it is neither a new proof nor evidence of HSWM or LLM efficacy.

archive_boundary.private_blob_statement: Each listed blob SHA-256 was recomputed locally on 2026-09-28; blobs remain private and are not redistributed by this record.

targets.name: Actual semantic lifecycle refinement reusing admission
targets.proposed_lean_boundary: Prove a trace/refinement relation from an admitted canonical revision through the selected execution that reads that exact successor. Reuse admission; do not prove a provider LLM's semantics, outcome truth, or improvement.
non_claims: No causal credit or fresh-evaluation guarantee

targets.name: Local-read sufficiency and task-read plan
targets.proposed_lean_boundary: Instantiate existing FibreCriterion for typed roles, exceptions, evidence and declared read/write sets, preserving Step and Learn guards/results. For approximate preservation separately supply an explicit interface, output error and coupling hypotheses.
non_claims: No claim that small local reads are sufficient for natural language

targets.name: History-conditional adaptive learning beyond the existing frozen round
targets.proposed_lean_boundary: Extend a frozen candidate round only with a filtration/history-conditioned fresh-sampling contract, explicit per-round error budget, contamination model, and candidate-freeze boundary.
non_claims: No inference of independence, contamination rate, or distribution stability from model confidence
No continual-learning or net-improvement theorem without its premises

targets.name: Versioned topology learning with consumer
targets.proposed_lean_boundary: Specify a versioned topology proposal, admission/rejection, lineage-preserving consumer read, and explicit candidate evaluation boundary.
non_claims: No claim that prompt evolution itself learns a canonical semantic weight
No test-set result transfers to HSWM

targets.name: Two-scale Step+Learn composition
targets.proposed_lean_boundary: Instantiate exact refinement for two cells; preserve Step and Learn, joint outcome, shared causes and conflicts. Model execution order or explicit rejection; retain utility-interference and XOR counterexamples. Approximate abstraction and small-gain contracts require their own stated hypotheses; causal credit is separate.
non_claims: No double-credit prevention without an explicit ownership theorem

sources.title: Learn then Test: Calibrating Predictive Algorithms to Achieve Risk Control
sources.assumptions: Fixed candidate family; independent IID calibration set; valid p-values under each null; an FWER-controlling procedure.
sources.non_claim: Controls erroneous selected hypotheses under its premises; it neither creates a useful revision nor licenses reuse of labels used to generate new candidates.

sources.title: Huber-Robust Confidence Sequences
sources.assumptions: A clean distribution and observed distribution in a stated total-variation/Huber-contamination neighborhood, known moment bound and contamination parameter; time-uniform supermartingale construction.
sources.non_claim: Its distributional contamination model is not the repository's bounded row-replacement witness and does not establish drift handling, candidate adaptivity, or improvement.

sources.title: Verification of General MDPs by Approximate Similarity Relations and Policy Refinement
sources.assumptions: State relation, output error ε, initial and transition liftings/couplings with δ, and an interface/refined policy over the stated gMDPs.
sources.non_claim: Transfers a bounded finite-horizon specification under supplied couplings; it does not prove an LLM local read is semantically sufficient.

sources.title: A Small Gain Theorem for Parametric Assume-Guarantee Contracts
sources.assumptions: Each component satisfies its parametric contract; guarantees imply feedback assumptions; required external/initial feedback conditions; metric/contraction conditions for the small-gain result.
sources.non_claim: Feedback syntax alone gives no HSWM learning gain, causal credit, or unrestricted recursive stability.

sources.title: Compositional Abstraction Error and a Category of Causal Models
sources.relevant_scope: Proposition 2.12 and its Jensen-Shannon-distance compositional abstraction-error construction
sources.assumptions: Finite interventional causal models and declared transformations, using the paper's Jensen-Shannon distance; error is relative to a reference model, not ground truth. An arbitrary metric or Learn preservation is not supplied by this proposition.
sources.non_claim: Compositional error bounds do not identify real causes, validate LLM-generated causal models, or prove HSWM improvement.

sources.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
sources.assumptions: Prompt-level candidate generation/reflection and the paper's benchmark splits, evaluator, budget and selected model configurations.
sources.non_claim: Experimental prompt optimization is a candidate-generator comparator only; it neither writes HSWM canonical state nor proves topology-learning correctness.

sources.title: Hyperon: The Open-Source Infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence

comparator.maturity_boundary: MeTTa/AtomSpace/MORK core is recorded as implementation capability; transformer bridge as prototype/research hypothesis; TECAN as specified design/research programme.

sources.non_claim: Mandatory architecture/empirical comparator only; this source map neither adopts Hyperon nor asserts an integrated benchmarked neural closed loop.
